messages:
frances: quick microcopy check for the "Session timeout" inline warning that appears when a user is idle on the Console. Current text: "Session expired. Refresh." — feels abrupt and not helpful. Figma: https://figma.redwood/session-timeout (frame)
omar: Agreed. We should tell users what happened and what they can do. Candidates:
- "You were signed out due to inactivity. Sign in to continue."
- "Your session expired. Save your work and sign back in." (but we can't always save)

lucy: I like the first one because it's clear and actionable. For accessibility, the message should be announced when it appears and the primary action should be "Sign in" not "Refresh". Also avoid jargon like "session" for some users; maybe "signed out" is clearer.
frances: Good point. UX wants to avoid surprise: if there are unsaved changes, we should surface that too. Proposed final copy:
"You were signed out due to inactivity. Sign in to continue."
Button: "Sign in" Secondary link: "Learn about session timeouts" (links to docs).

omar: Implementation notes: use role="alert" so SRs hear it right away, but make sure it doesn't steal focus from modal dialogs. If unsaved changes exist show an additional helper: "Unsaved changes may be lost." and a confirm overlay when they try to navigate away.
lucy: Also be mindful of localization length; keep primary sentence under ~70 chars. For mobile use a compact variant: "Signed out due to inactivity. Sign in." Button text: "Sign in" fits.
frances: tiny wording tweak: replace "Sign in to continue" with "Sign in to continue your work"? feels friendlier.
omar: I prefer the shorter one. Extra words can bloat translations. Keep: "Sign in to continue."
frances: OK final lock: Message: "You were signed out due to inactivity. Sign in to continue." Button: "Sign in" Secondary link: "Session timeout docs". Accessibility: role=alert, ensure the link is descriptive, and if unsaved changes exist add helper: "Unsaved changes may be lost.". Ticket will include acceptance criteria + Figma frame.
td-bot: Ticket #4911 created with final copy and ARIA guidance. Figma frame id: figma://frame/session-timeout/3. (auto-note)
lucy: One last nit: animation for the banner entrance should respect prefers-reduced-motion. I'll add that to the ticket too. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
